title: Hoeffding adaptive splitting trees for data stream classification with concept drift and ensemble learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.16659v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ensembles of decision trees are well-established methods for data stream classification. In ensemble learning, Hoeffding Trees are widely adopted as base learners, performing periodic split attempts according to the Hoeffding bound. Recent studies, however, indicate that this standard splitting mechanism lacks adaptability, while adaptive trees that trigger splits in response to performance degradation have achieved superior results. In this paper, we identify limitations in the use of adaptive-splitting decision trees as ensemble base learners, showing that change detectors often fail to promote sufficient diversity within ensembles. To address this issue, we propose two novel decision tree models, termed Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees. translated_title: 霍夫丁自适应分裂树用于具有概念漂移和集成学习的数据流分类
translated_abstract: 决策树集成是数据流分类中成熟的方法。在集成学习中，霍夫丁树被广泛用作基学习器，根据霍夫丁界定期进行分裂尝试。然而，近期研究表明，这种标准分裂机制缺乏适应性，而响应性能退化触发分裂的自适应树已取得更优结果。本文中，我们识别了自适应分裂决策树作为集成基学习器时的局限性，显示变化检测器往往无法在集成中促进足够的多样性。为解决此问题，我们提出了两种新颖的决策树模型，称为霍夫丁自适应分裂树。这些模型结合了霍夫丁树的定期分裂策略（该策略促进集成多样性）与采用变化检测算法的自适应分裂机制，以识别每个节点上的变化。
tldr: 本文提出霍夫丁自适应分裂树，通过结合定期分裂与自适应分裂机制，解决了自适应树在集成学习中多样性不足的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees, which combine periodic and adaptive splitting to address the diversity issue of adaptive trees in ensemble learning.
